plain_description.what: Re-posts the exact same 300 judge requests of the new (v2) judge recipe and counts how often the combined verdict changes. A second leg will re-run the older v1 canary set about two weeks later to check for drift. About 1,800 calls are planned in total: 1,200 for the v2 leg (done) and 600 for the v1 leg (pending, not before 2026-10-08).
plain_description.why: It sets the judge's own noise floor, so that later changes in verdicts can be told apart from random judge wobble or drift over time.
plain_description.information: A low, stable retest rate means verdict changes above it are real; a high one means the judge is noisy. Result so far (paused): the v2 leg is done, and verdicts change on 10% of re-posted matches (about 7% to 13%). This is descriptive only and is a noise floor, not accuracy. The v1 epoch-3 leg and the drift-over-time comparison are still pending.
